purpose: Reconstruct the cycle-producing interfaces nearest the post-WP00 frontier. This is a target-selection ledger, not a comprehensive bibliography of every known Hodge case.
claim_boundary: A listed theorem is prior art, not a GCL result. An open entry is not evidence of novelty. Selected-class algebraicity is distinguished from full cycle-class surjectivity.

source_refresh.material_change: The Forge baseline predates current 2025-2026 secant-sheaf results. Abelian fourfolds and split-Weil sixfold Weil classes are now theorem terrain, while Markman's CM-field construction supplies an explicit genus-four coherent-sheaf lane on an abelian eightfold with one named missing semiregularity bridge.

families.variety_class: smooth projective complex varieties of dimension at most three
families.construction_mechanism: p=0 and p=n use component/point generators; p=1 uses Lefschetz (1,1); p=n-1 uses hard Lefschetz on rational Hodge structures and algebraic hyperplane multiplication.
Zucker's theorem is a genuine dimension-four codimension-two known case; the current Forge package records its primary theorem source but does not use it as a new target.

families.variety_class: abelian fourfolds of Weil type, arbitrary imaginary quadratic field and discriminant
families.construction_mechanism: Markman's split-sixfold secant-sheaf theorem constructs the relevant Weil classes; a degeneration argument supplies the fourfold consequence. Known Hodge-ring structure then reduces the remaining classes to divisor-generated classes and Weil classes.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: all rational Hodge classes in the stated abelian-fourfold terrain

families.variety_class: complex abelian varieties of dimension at most five
families.construction_mechanism: Markman's current account records that the fourfold Weil-class result, together with known Hodge-ring structure, yields the Hodge conjecture for abelian varieties of dimension at most five.

families.variety_class: polarized abelian sixfolds of split Weil type for an imaginary quadratic field
families.classification: generation of the Weil subspace is known
families.construction_mechanism: Secant coherent sheaves on a principally polarized abelian threefold are carried by Fourier-Mukai/Orlov transport to a semiregular object with normalized Chern class having a nonzero Weil component. Semiregularity transports algebraicity through the split-Weil component, and the algebraic K-action generates the full one-dimensional-over-K Weil space.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: all Weil classes on the split-Weil sixfold family
families.target_use: reject as prior art; retain the mechanism as template

families.variety_class: generic Weil-type deformations of Markman's genus-four real-multiplication construction with [K:Q]=4
families.classification: genuinely open boundary with an explicit algebraic construction mechanism
families.construction_mechanism: Take X a genus-four Jacobian with real multiplication by a real quadratic field F and K=F(sqrt(-q)) in the biquadratic case used by Markman. Example 11.2.7 constructs coherent B-secant sheaves. Lemma 11.2.8 proves that the Orlov/Fourier-Mukai object E has nonzero rank, that its normalized class kappa(E) remains Hodge under Weil-type deformation, and that the degree-four component has a nonzero projection to HW. Since HW is one-dimensional over K and K acts by algebraic correspondences, one algebraic nonzero Weil class would generate every Weil class. The source explicitly leaves semiregularity of E unproved; that is the missing algebraicity-transport bridge.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: on the Hodge-generic locus, degree-four rational Hodge classes are divisor products plus HW, so arbitrary-input surjectivity reduces to algebraicity of the transported nonzero Weil component
families.source: MARKMAN-CM-SECANT-2025 Introduction 1.1, Proposition 8.0.1, Proposition 10.2.1, Example 11.2.7, Lemma 11.2.8

families.variety_class: quadratic-CM split-Weil abelian eightfolds approached through the speculative higher-dimensional secant complex
families.construction_mechanism: Markman's Section 12 describes a higher-dimensional secant complex and points to the weak-semiregularity question, but the CM-degree-four genus-four lane already supplies coherent secant sheaves plus the rank and nonzero-Weil-projection checks.
families.target_use: defer in favor of HC-KC-006 because more construction obligations are already discharged there

selection.reason: HC-KC-006 is source-defined, nontrivial, outside current theorem terrain, and already supplies coherent secant sheaves, nonzero rank, Hodge persistence, and a nonzero Weil projection. Its remaining obstruction is sharply localized to semiregularity/algebraicity transport. The smaller non-split sixfold boundary currently lacks such an executable construction path.
selection.non_implication: Selection does not prove the target, establish novelty or priority, cover special fibers with extra Hodge classes, or imply the universal Hodge conjecture.
